identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase I Study of the Safety and Efficacy of CD19 CAR-T Cells in Patients With Relapsed or Refractory Acute B-cell Lymphoblastic Leukemia (R/R B-ALL)

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: In this single-center, open-label, nonrandomized, no control, prospective clinical trial, no less than 18 CD19+ B-cell relapsed or refractory acute B-cell lymphoblastic leukemia (R/R B-ALL) patients will be enrolled. Side effects of CD19 CAR T cells therapy will be monitored. The purpose of current study is to determine the clinical efficacy and safety of CD19 CAR T cells therapy in patients with R/R B-ALL.
